label: Readwise Source
description: A Readwise source shared by independently usable Reader and Highlights connectors.

account.description: The stable, nonsecret account label used in the natural key.

external_id.description: The identifier in the upstream source system; retained for Reader linking.

tags.description: Trimmed, distinct Readwise tag names, preserving case and Unicode.

readable_title.description: The display title supplied by Readwise.

readwise_source.description: The service the source was imported from.

source_url.description: The source URL as Readwise supplied it.

cover_image_url.description: The cover URL as Readwise supplied it.

canonical_key.description: Account-scoped canonical identity shared by Reader and Highlights.

reader_id.description: The verified Reader document or highlight ID.

reader_managed.description: Whether Reader owns the shared mutable fields.

reader_parent_id.description: The Reader parent document ID, when present.

reader_metadata.description: Reader metadata retained without coercing vendor values.

reader_notes.description: Reader note records keyed by their vendor IDs.

reader_text_files.description: Natural keys of file items preserving over-limit text completely.

reader_first_opened_at.description: The original Reader first opened at.

reader_last_opened_at.description: The original Reader last opened at.

reader_last_moved_at.description: The original Reader last moved at.

reader_create.description: Explicit intent to create this local item in Reader; cleared after its Reader identity is confirmed.
